facts.fact: Brawley 等待 Kayla 再次离开的几天里，第一次追问自己的感情来源
facts.anchor: Do I care because of Vero, or is she someone I might have feelings for as well?

facts.fact: Vero 让 Banks 植入芯片，紧急联系人只填 Brawley 一人
facts.anchor: he listed you as his emergency contact. Only you

facts.fact: Banks 观察出 Kayla 的创伤行为模式：谨慎、记出口、自己无意识
facts.anchor: She moves with caution, maps exits in every room, and I don’t think she even knows she is doing it

facts.fact: Banks 判断：Vero 被她召唤，说明她自带心魔
facts.anchor: For Vero to call to her, she has some demons of her own

facts.fact: Brawley 对 Kayla 使用他对 Vero 的后颈安抚法，她整个人放松下来
facts.anchor: Kayla’s eyes don’t leave mine as I cross the room and put my hand on the back of her neck, the same way I do to Vero. Her whole body relaxes

facts.fact: Vero 求 Kayla 留下，她只要「尽力」的承诺而非保证
facts.anchor: Don’t make promises you can’t keep. Just promise you will try

facts.fact: Brawley 在亲密中声明排他；随后自评她属于我们四人各自的方式
facts.anchor: I won’t let anyone else see her like this—anyone outside this house

facts.fact: 章末 Brawley 承认：有人与他同样亲近 Vero，对他自己也是解脱
facts.anchor: I have a feeling that having someone else as close to him as I am will be good for me
